description: Arbitrary-order, integer, receipt-grounded program prefix construction under a situated graph budget, with relational Pareto refutation and output-null curiosity selection.

rules.name: ept_open_situated_program_trajectory
rules.comment: A situated owner requests arbitrary-order program composition under a horizon held by its current budget context.

rules.name: ept_refresh_situated_trajectory_horizon_from_budget
rules.comment: An existing trajectory deepens as its situated evidence window grows. The owner retains one trajectory identity; only the graph-held expansion horizon changes.

rules.name: ept_mint_verified_order_one_path
rules.comment: Every verified edge is the depth-one prefix. Its state coordinates and costs remain separate Pareto dimensions.

rules.name: ept_extend_path_with_compatible_verified_transition
rules.comment: Extend prefixes only through a shared program state and only while the situated graph horizon remains open.

rules.name: ept_situate_path_in_current_state_shape
rules.comment: Cache the least residual between a retained path and the owner's current receipt-grounded transition sources. This is a situated selection coordinate, not new transition evidence.

rules.name: ept_retract_selected_path_when_counterexample_arrives
rules.comment: A later relational counterexample changes the next collapse; it never interrupts an already issued motor outcome.

rules.name: ept_collapse_frontier_to_one_practice_path
rules.comment: Pareto removes only refuted paths. Temporal foveation first restricts choice to the shortest sufficient prefix. When a situated manifold context exists, a second Pareto restriction removes only paths dominated in all seven conditional retained-future dimensions; no scalar capacity score is formed. Situated task, evidence, and practice coordinates order the surviving tradeoffs. Selection grants no actuator authority.

rules.name: ept_deepen_trajectory_after_local_frontier_exhaustion
rules.comment: Temporal foveation holds farther futures as potential. Expose one additional order only after the manifold explicitly blocks a path at the active depth; deeper orders require their own new local block evidence.
